entries.name: AG2 (AutoGen)
entries.use_for: Build conversational multi-agent systems where agents talk to each other and use tools.
entries.why: Community continuation of the original AutoGen; established multi-agent conversation patterns.

entries.name: Agent Development Kit (ADK)
entries.use_for: Build, evaluate and deploy code-first agents and multi-agent systems.
entries.why: Google's official agent toolkit; built-in eval, dev UI and deployment to Vertex/Cloud Run, model-agnostic.

entries.name: Agent S
entries.use_for: Build computer-use agents that operate desktop GUIs like a human
entries.why: Open computer-use agent framework with state-of-the-art OSWorld results; Apache-2.0.

entries.name: AgentScope
entries.use_for: Build transparent, observable multi-agent applications with MCP and tool support.
entries.why: Actively developed (33k stars) multi-agent framework from Alibaba with strong visibility into agent runs.

entries.name: Agno
entries.use_for: Build multi-agent systems with memory, knowledge and tools, plus a runtime to serve them.
entries.why: Fast-growing Python agent framework (~43k stars) with teams, memory, RAG and a production runtime.

entries.name: ART
entries.use_for: Train multi-step agents with reinforcement learning (GRPO)
entries.why: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: plugs RL fine-tuning into existing agent code to improve reliability on real tasks.

entries.name: CAMEL
entries.use_for: Build role-playing multi-agent systems and agent societies in Python
entries.why: One of the earliest multi-agent frameworks; 238 contributors, toolkits, memory and workforce orchestration, Apache-2.0.

entries.name: Claude Agent SDK (Python)
entries.use_for: Build agents on the same harness that powers Claude Code, with tools, MCP and hooks.
entries.why: Official Anthropic SDK (~8k stars) exposing Claude Code's agent loop, file and shell tools and MCP support.

entries.name: CrewAI
entries.use_for: Orchestrate teams of role-based agents that collaborate on tasks.
entries.why: Popular multi-agent framework (60k stars) with a simple crew/task model, independent of LangChain.

entries.name: DSPy
entries.use_for: Program LLM pipelines and agents declaratively and optimise their prompts automatically.
entries.why: Stanford's framework (~39k stars) that replaces hand-written prompts with optimisable modules.

entries.name: LangChain
entries.use_for: Build LLM apps and agents with a huge library of model, tool and retriever integrations.
entries.why: The most widely adopted LLM framework (148k stars, 3.7k contributors); largest integration ecosystem.

entries.name: LangChain.js
entries.use_for: Build LLM apps and agents in TypeScript with LangChain's integrations.
entries.why: JS/TS port of LangChain (~3M weekly npm downloads) with hundreds of model, tool and vector store integrations.

entries.name: LangChain4j
entries.use_for: Build LLM apps, tools and agents on the JVM with a unified provider API
entries.why: The de facto Java LLM/agent library: 500+ contributors, 20+ model providers, RAG, tools and Spring/Quarkus integrations.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.use_for: Build stateful, long-running agents as graphs with persistence, human-in-the-loop and streaming.
entries.why: Low-level, controllable orchestration with durable state; the production agent runtime of the LangChain ecosystem.

entries.name: Letta
entries.use_for: Run stateful agents with long-term memory that persist across sessions.
entries.why: Formerly MemGPT (~25k stars); agents with self-editing memory, served via an API server.

entries.name: LiveKit Agents
entries.use_for: Build realtime voice/video AI agents on WebRTC
entries.why: Production voice-agent framework from LiveKit with turn detection, telephony and many provider plugins; 540+ contributors.

entries.name: Mastra
entries.use_for: Build AI agents, workflows and RAG in TypeScript with memory, evals and tracing.
entries.why: Leading TypeScript agent framework (29k stars, ~700 contributors); integrates with the Vercel AI SDK.

entries.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
entries.use_for: Build and orchestrate agents and multi-agent workflows in Python or .NET.
entries.why: Microsoft successor to Semantic Kernel and AutoGen; first-class .NET and Python support.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
entries.use_for: Build multi-agent workflows with handoffs, guardrails and tracing in a lightweight SDK.
entries.why: Official OpenAI agents SDK; minimal primitives, provider-agnostic, 30k stars and 400+ contributors.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK (JS)
entries.use_for: Build multi-agent workflows with handoffs, guardrails and tracing in TypeScript.
entries.why: Official TS version of the OpenAI Agents SDK (~2.2M weekly npm downloads); also supports voice agents.

entries.name: Pipecat
entries.use_for: Build realtime voice and multimodal conversational agents
entries.why: Daily-maintained pipeline framework with 360+ contributors and plug-in STT/LLM/TTS and transport services.

entries.name: PocketFlow
entries.use_for: Tiny 100-line graph framework for agents, workflows and RAG
entries.why: Deliberately minimal, zero-dependency LLM framework that is easy to read and fork; popular base for agent-coded projects.

entries.name: Pydantic AI
entries.use_for: Build type-safe Python agents with validated structured outputs and tool calls.
entries.why: From the Pydantic team; model-agnostic, strongly typed, with dependency injection and evals built in.

entries.name: Semantic Kernel
entries.use_for: Add AI agents and plugins to .NET, Python or Java apps.
entries.why: Microsoft's model-agnostic SDK (~29k stars), strongest choice for .NET agent and plugin orchestration.

entries.name: smolagents
entries.use_for: Build lightweight agents that write and run Python code as their actions.
entries.why: Hugging Face's minimal agent library (~30k stars); code-first agents, any model, sandboxed execution.

entries.name: Spring AI Alibaba
entries.use_for: Build graph-based multi-agent workflows in Spring Boot apps
entries.why: Alibaba's agentic framework on top of Spring AI, with graph orchestration and multi-agent patterns for Java teams.

entries.name: Strands Agents SDK
entries.use_for: Build production agents with a model-driven loop, tools and MCP support.
entries.why: Open-source agent SDK from AWS (Apache-2.0, 300+ contributors); minimal code, any model provider.

entries.name: VoltAgent
entries.use_for: Build TypeScript agents with tools, memory, sub-agents and a built-in observability console.
entries.why: Open-source TS agent framework with integrated tracing/debugging console; MIT licensed.
